nodes.description: Array of AggregatorV3Interface price feed oracles storing token-to-ETH feeds.
AggregatorV3Interface oracle providing the ETH/USD price.
IAdmin admin contract reference used for privileged access checks.
ChainlinkPriceFeed constructor: pushes initial price feeds, sets ETH/USD feed and admin.
Public function that pushes a new price feed after verifying msg.sender is admin.
Public view function reading latest oracle rounds and returning a computed price.
Caller-controlled address used for the admin authorization check in addPriceFeed.
External call admin.admin() executed during addPriceFeed access-control validation.
External calls to priceFeed[idx] and priceFeedETHToUSD latestRoundData() in getLatestPrice.
Arithmetic mul/div sequence computing uint(priceETH)*uint(priceUSD)/1e18 in getLatestPrice.
Constructor parameter address used to initialize the admin contract reference.
Address parameter of addPriceFeed wrapping a new AggregatorV3Interface feed.
Index parameter of getLatestPrice selecting the price feed from the array.
Local int price returned by priceFeed[idx].latestRoundData() in getLatestPrice.
Local timestamp returned by priceFeed[idx].latestRoundData() in getLatestPrice.
Local int price returned by priceFeedETHToUSD.latestRoundData() in getLatestPrice.
Local timestamp returned by priceFeedETHToUSD.latestRoundData() in getLatestPrice.

edges.reason: priceFeed state array is read and length-checked inside getLatestPrice.
priceFeedETHToUSD state oracle is queried inside getLatestPrice.
admin state variable is read to authorize addPriceFeed.
constructor pushes initial feeds into the priceFeed array.
constructor assigns the ETH/USD aggregator to priceFeedETHToUSD.
constructor sets the admin contract from the adminAddress parameter.
msg.sender flows into the admin authorization check of addPriceFeed.
msg.sender is compared against the result of the admin.admin() external call.
addPriceFeed invocation triggers the external admin.admin() call as a require check.
addPriceFeed pushes a new feed into the priceFeed state array.
getLatestPrice invokes latestRoundData() on both oracle interfaces.
getLatestPrice performs a mul/div arithmetic sequence on oracle returned values.
adminAddress parameter is used by the constructor to set the admin state.
addr parameter is wrapped into an AggregatorV3Interface and pushed in addPriceFeed.
idx parameter indexes the priceFeed array inside getLatestPrice.
priceETH local receives the price returned by the oracle latestRoundData call.
timeStampETH local receives the timestamp returned by the oracle latestRoundData call.
priceUSD local receives the ETH/USD price returned by the oracle call.
timeStampUSD local receives the ETH/USD timestamp returned by the oracle call.
priceETH local is cast to uint and multiplied inside the price arithmetic operation.
priceUSD local is cast to uint and used as multiplier/divisor of the price arithmetic.
timeStampETH is validated with a require, gating execution flow of the price path.
timeStampUSD is validated with a require, gating execution flow of the price path.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the assignment of the admin state variable and has no standalone semantics.
Parameter is only used to construct and push a new AggregatorV3Interface inside addPriceFeed.
Index parameter is only used to select and bounds-check an entry of priceFeed in getLatestPrice.
Local variable is the direct return value of the oracle latestRoundData call.
Local variable is the direct timestamp return value of the oracle latestRoundData call.
Local variable is the direct ETH/USD return value of the oracle latestRoundData call.
Local variable is the direct ETH/USD timestamp return value of the oracle latestRoundData call.
